issues.title: Ingest Prairie County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $7,000,187 across 22 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($2,900,861), County Road Fund ($2,076,733), Jail Operations Maintenance Fund ($1,070,149). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
